regions.breakdown: Achtung is a German noun meaning 'attention' or 'warning', commonly used as an exclamation to mean 'Caution!' or 'Watch out!'.
Böser is the strong nominative masculine singular form of the adjective 'böse' (bad/evil). Hund means 'dog'. Together, 'Bad Dog'.

regions.original: Auch böses Herrchen, böses Frauchen, böse Kinder ... ganze Familie ist böse!
regions.translation: Also bad master, bad mistress, bad children ... the whole family is bad!
regions.breakdown: Auch: also. Böses: neuter singular form of 'böse' (bad), used for 'Herrchen' (male owner, diminutive) and 'Frauchen' (female owner, diminutive). Böse: plural form of 'böse' for 'Kinder' (children). Ganze Familie: entire family. Ist: is. Ist böse: is bad.

where_youd_see_it: You would see this sign on a gate or fence of a private property.
cultural_note: This is a humorous variation of the common 'Beware of Dog' sign, often found in Germany. It plays on the stereotype of a fierce dog by implying the entire family shares the dog's 'bad' nature, adding a lighthearted touch to a warning.
